items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: Marty Paich, very difficult taskmaster. But you would read about the things people had written and a lot of times it just didn’t match up with the person that I had gotten to know.

ctx.x: That’s nice that you’re able to marry those two aspects of your career together. I’ve had a similar thing I’ve been able to do with our archive and a local Arts-In-Education institute over the years, and it really works well if you think it out.

Yeah. And that’s really the key. And again, with your archive of making sure those things are available and having them there for people to access and things like that, that’s so © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

important. But as you know, that’s not always the case. And a lot of times — and I think the idea behind the whole thing started back in the KLON days when I started to put — not only was I doing the events but also the radio shows that I’ve always done have been more like kind of documentary oriented.
